To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a compiler framework that combines superword statement generation with data layout optimization can significantly improve superword parallelism; 2) the statement grouping algorithm can be used to increase superword parallelism by a factor of 2.3 on average; and 3) our data layout optimization is effective in minimizing memory operations and improving superword parallelism.

(i) our SLP compiler framework is the first of its kind that can generate SLP code for a wide class of applications; (ii) it is the first to use a global data access and reusability analysis in order to improve SLP exploitation, and (iii) it is the only SLP compiler that can perform data layout optimization.

(i) the proposed compiler framework is effective at improving SLP exploitation; (ii) the proposed compiler can generate superword statements that capture more superword level reuse; and (iii) the proposed compiler is effective at improving data access and reuse patterns for superword level parallelization.
